RadPrimer.role: Canonical hierarchy and base testicular carcinoma article.
limitations: Less granular AJCC/TNM staging and fewer metastatic case examples than STATdx.
STATdx breadcrumb is not used for deck hierarchy because RadPrimer is present.

sourceAttributionRules.default: Tag factual blocks as [RadPrimer], [STATdx], or [Both] where the distinction matters.
sourceAttributionRules.humanFacingImages: Use labels like RadPrimer image 5 or STATdx image 24 in prose.
sourceAttributionRules.traceability: Use masterImageId values only in registry/import/report metadata.

textBackbone.primary: RadPrimer supplies the canonical disease article backbone, sonographic appearance by histology, baseline differential, and original hierarchy.
textBackbone.supplement: STATdx supplies the staging-focused TNM/AJCC framework, nodal drainage maps, metastatic work-up, risk/prognostic staging, restaging/surveillance detail, and richer multimodality examples.
textBackbone.downweight: Do not treat either source as Core Radiology. No Core evidence was supplied in this bundle.

sourceSelectionPlan.imageCurationPolicy: Exact duplicates may be archived. Near duplicates, alternate patients, alternate modality examples, stage variants, and conceptual replacements remain in the primaryTeachingSet as recognition reinforcement unless visually identical or unusable.
sourceSelectionPlan.duplicateEvidencePolicy: Exact duplicate calls require visual evidence from image_evidence files, matching source image IDs, image hashes, or explicit source/manual confirmation. Caption-only or topic-only similarity is insufficient.

RP-01: RadPrimer graphic teaches mass replacement; STATdx T-stage graphics teach invasion extent rather than the same graphic.
RP-02: Same seminoma/solid hypoechoic vascular mass teaching need, but different ultrasound images/patients.
RP-03: Small hypoechoic vascular testicular mass concept is covered, but not by the same image.
RP-04: Cystic/calcified nonseminomatous tumor and burned-out/microlithiasis examples overlap conceptually, but images are visually distinct.
RP-05: Tunica/extratesticular invasion and mixed tumor concept overlaps, but the visual examples are different.
RP-06: Large heterogeneous mass teaching is reinforced by STATdx, but no same image/slice is present.
RP-07: Ill-defined heterogeneous invasive tumor concept is reinforced, but source images are different.
RP-08: Retroperitoneal nodal metastasis is extensively covered by STATdx; CT slices/cases are distinct.

caseClusterGuardrails.policy: Same-patient and stage-demonstration clusters should stay atomic when used in narrative/card generation.
clustersToPreserve: STATdx bulky nodal and M1a cluster
STATdx heterogeneous seminoma US same-patient cluster
STATdx small seminoma US/MR same-patient cluster

generatorInstructions: Use source-qualified human-facing labels such as RadPrimer image 5 and STATdx image 24.
Keep short IDs such as RP-05 and SDX-24 in traceability fields, filenames, and registry metadata.
For cards, separate primary tumor recognition, TNM staging, nodal pathways, serum markers, and metastatic-risk groups rather than mixing them into overloaded prompts.
Do not generate unsupported Core cross-check statements from this master source.
